name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Boyle with $5.6M cash on hand
Challenger Arriaga has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Boyle holds a heavily Democratic Philadelphia-area seat with a large financial advantage and no outside spending against him, while Arriaga shows no measurable campaign infrastructure. Fundamentals and prediction markets both point to an easy incumbent win.
model.watch: A surprise primary loss for Boyle or a late influx of outside money against him would be the only realistic path to tightening.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle is seeking another term in a Philadelphia-area district that leans Democratic by about nineteen points. He has raised roughly $2.5 million and holds $5.6 million on hand, with no outside spending opposing him. Republican challenger Jessica Arriaga has no reported fundraising or cash on hand, and no expert raters list the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price a Boyle win near 97 percent. With no public polling and a challenger lacking visible resources, the race rests on district partisanship and incumbency, both of which strongly favor the Democrat. Boyle is heavily favored to return to Congress.
